hero.tag: In the arms of the mountains — feel the calm
hero.text: Escape the noise of the city and relax in the mountain air. Cozy A-frame cottages, beautiful views and an atmosphere made for taking time for yourself are waiting for you.

about.title: Close to nature, close to yourself
about.text: Calma Mountain is a place to rest from everyday worries and enjoy the quiet of nature. Beautiful mountain views, cozy cottages and pleasant moments on the terrace make your stay special.

concept.p1: We created Calma Mountain as an intimate space for two.
concept.p2: Each cottage comfortably accommodates 2 adults, or a family of 2 adults and 1 child.
concept.p3: Our format is not suitable for large groups and noisy events.Thank you for understanding and respecting the atmosphere of privacy and tranquility.

alba.description: A cozy A-frame cottage with panoramic windows and mountain views, made for relaxing.

nimbus.description: A cozy space with a light-filled interior and views of the mountain landscapes.

eclipse.description: A deeper interior and a warm atmosphere.

terra.description: An A-frame cottage for relaxing on the terrace and enjoying the calm of nature.

chat.hello: Hello! I can answer common questions about cottages and booking.
chat.fallback: I couldn't find an exact answer. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll help with dates and prices.

faq.question: Hello
faq.answer: Hello! Ask me about prices, check-in times, what is included or how to book.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: Weekdays from 12,000 KGS, weekends from 14,000 KGS per cottage. See exact prices in the Cottages section.

faq.question: What is included?
faq.answer: Stay for 2 guests, breakfast, parking, tea/coffee area, BBQ area and a private terrace.

faq.question: How many guests fit?
faq.answer: Each cottage fits 2 adults and 1 child. Larger groups are not suitable for our format.

faq.question: How do I book?
faq.answer: Open the Cottages page, pick a cottage and press “Book this cottage”. Choose your dates and contact details — the price is calculated automatically.

faq.question: How can I contact you?
faq.answer: Message us on WhatsApp (button below) or call +996 555 123 456.
